title: 第19章 心魔第20章 谁问你了
content_zh:
;;
买？
买个屁！
花一百个w充游戏，劳资岂不是脑子瓦特了？
但话又说回来了，这毕竟是自己的外挂，花钱如果能让自己的实力有极大的加强，那这个钱还是值得的。
男人嘛，总要有魄力一点。
花钱抠抠搜搜的岂是男儿本色？
再说了，钱财之类的不过是身外之物，何须太过在意？
钱嘛，虽然现在花了，但总能挣回来的。
今日花的钱，日后必会以其他形式陪伴在自己身边。
所以花钱，不应该叫做“花钱”，叫花钱就俗了，应该叫做“让钱真正的发挥作用”！
嗯！没错！
在经过了百般心理建设之后，云阳终于狠下心来，点了最贵的红色机缘。
既然有折扣，那自然就要买最贵的，要是买了便宜的，那不就亏了吗？
输入支付密码，一瞬间，云阳的账户余额就少了五十个w。
【您已获得红色品质的资源，请打开背包点击使用。】
这游戏果然是特么的病毒软件吧，如此数量的消费银行那边竟然一点限额和提醒都没有，仿佛就和花了五十块钱一样。
啊不，自己一次直接在游戏里充五十块钱也是会很心疼的说。
这一刻云阳突然觉得自己变了，这五十万花的竟然一点实感都没有，竟然说花就花出去了。
怎么感觉自己就像那种小说男主似的，这钱说话就花，一点都不含糊的。

瞎勾八想什么呢自己？云阳摇了摇头。
这或许就像贤者时刻一样，在决定是否付款的时候犹豫的要死，翻来覆去的去想，在最高潮时冲动的摁下付款键，但当付完款后的一瞬间，马上就进入了某种虚无感中。
我刚刚干了什么？
我把钱花出去了？
整个过程很像xxoo。
不对。
云阳再三斟酌了一下，又觉得这个过程更像炉才对。
因为花完钱后就会后悔，就像炉过后就会后悔刚刚又做了件无用功似的。
所以说，花自己难以负担的钱就和小楚男道馆一样，都是一时冲动，强行满足欲望罢了。
本就是无意义之举。
阿弥陀佛，善哉善哉。
关上这个“巨垃圾病毒充钱手游”，云阳又打开手机上的银行app，看着里面缩短的金额长度，心痛的感觉瞬间涌上心头。
啊！是心痛的感觉！
劳资的钱！
tm的！要是你这个红色品质的机缘不能让我满意的话，劳资拆了你这个“巨垃圾病毒充钱手游”！
点开游戏里的背包选项，点击那个红色品质的机缘，然后使用。
【您已使用红色品质机缘，现为您搜索机缘中……】
【叮！已为您搜索到最近的红色品质机缘！】
【请您前往当前所在的山峰的后山位置，于后山的（x：332，y：256，z：976）位置连续修炼三十日即可获得红色品质机缘。】
怎么不是直接给我？

还有触发条件？
content_en:
;;
purchase?
Buy shit!
Spending 100 w to recharge the game, wouldn’t the labor and management have lost their minds?
But then again, this is my own plug-in after all. If the money you spend can greatly enhance your strength, then the money is still worth it.
Men, you have to be brave.
Is it true that a man who spends money to dig and search is not his true nature?
Besides, money and the like are just external things, so why should you care too much?
Money, although it is spent now, can always be earned back.
The money you spend today will definitely accompany you in other forms in the future.
Therefore, spending money should not be called "spending money". It is vulgar to call it spending money. It should be called "making money really work"!
Um! That's right!
After going through various psychological preparations, Yunyang finally made up his mind and ordered the most expensive red opportunity.
Since there is a discount, naturally you have to buy the most expensive one. If you buy the cheap one, wouldn’t you lose money?
After entering the payment password, Yunyang's account balance was reduced by fifty w in an instant.
[You have obtained red quality resources, please open your backpack and click to use it. 】
This game is indeed some kind of virus software. With such a large number of consumer banks, there are no limits or reminders at all, as if it was like spending fifty yuan.
Ah no, I would be very distressed if I directly charge fifty yuan into the game at a time.
At this moment, Yunyang suddenly felt that he had changed. He had no real sense of the five hundred thousand dollars spent, and actually spent it just as he said it would.
Why do I feel like one of those novel male protagonists who spends the money as he pleases without any ambiguity at all.
What are you thinking about? Yunyang shook his head.
This may be like a moment of sage. When deciding whether to pay, you hesitate to death, think over and over again, and impulsively press the payment button at the climax, but the moment after you finish paying, you immediately enter a sense of nothingness.
What did I just do?
Did I spend the money?
The whole process is very similar to xxoo.
wrong.
Yunyang thought about it again and again, and felt that this process was more like a furnace.
Because you will regret it after you spend the money, just like you will regret having done something useless after the fire is over.
Therefore, spending money that you can't afford is just like Xiao Chunan's gym. It's just impulsive and forcibly satisfying desires.
This is a meaningless move.
Amitabha, good, good, good.
After closing this "giant junk virus money-charging mobile game", Yunyang opened the bank app on his mobile phone again. Looking at the shortened amount of money inside, a feeling of heartache instantly filled his heart.
ah! It’s a heartbreaking feeling!
Labor money!
Damn it! If you can't satisfy me with your red-quality opportunity, labor and management will dismantle this "giant junk virus money-charging mobile game" of yours!
Click on the backpack option in the game, click on the red quality opportunity, and then use it.
[You have used the red quality opportunity, now you are searching for the opportunity...]
[Ding! The nearest red quality opportunity has been searched for you! 】
[Please go to the back mountain location of the mountain you are currently on. Practice at the (x: 332, y: 256, z: 976) position of the back mountain for 30 consecutive days to obtain the red quality opportunity. 】
Why didn't you give it to me directly?
Are there any trigger conditions?
